welcome.title: One place to organize your team's support.
welcome.description: NexoDesk is being developed to bring customers, teams and support requests together in one place.
welcome.development_notice: Work in progress. Company and ticket management features will be available later.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Organize each company with its own team and data.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Keep your company's customer details and contact information together.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Track support requests, set priorities and assign team members.

login.title: Log in to your account
login.description: Enter your email and password to continue.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Enter your details to create your account.

forgot_password.title: Forgot password
forgot_password.description: Enter your email to receive a password reset link.

reset_password.title: Reset password
reset_password.description: Enter and confirm your new password.

confirm.title: Confirm password
confirm.description: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.authentication_description: Enter the code provided by your authenticator application.
two_factor.recovery_description: Confirm access to your account by entering one of your emergency recovery codes.

verify_email.title: Email verification
verify_email.description: Please verify your email address by clicking the link we emailed to you.
verify_email.sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.
